structuredOutput.summary: Added docs/research/dsr.md, an implementation-grade DSR literature note. It covers bibliographic sources (Bailey & López de Prado 2014 DSR; 2012 PSR; Lo/Mertens/Opdyke auxiliaries), formulas 2.a–2.d with paper equation citations and symbol tables (SR estimator and non-Normal SE, PSR, expected-max SR with Euler–Mascheroni terms, DSR as PSR at that benchmark), a paper-symbol→Python-name→runtime-source code-mapping plan without code, hand-worked test vectors for PSR/E[max]/DSR (plus a paper numerical-example cross-check), and implementation pitfalls (annualization, autocorrelation, independent vs raw trials, cross-trial variance, inverse-Normal tails).
